verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms ClickHouse serves an llms.txt at clickhouse.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Docs pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs), and the CLI installs official agent skills into coding agents. Missing for 10: the root docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or hands-on report of agents actually using the llms.txt or markdown docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://clickhouse.com/llms.txt # ClickHouse
Install the official ClickHouse agent skills into supported coding agents
